key_insight: Training only on minimal corrections at the first reasoning failure improves instruction compliance while largely preserving untargeted skills.
engineering_relevance: Localized supervision offers a targeted alternative to imitating full reasoning traces or rewarding entire completions.
method: Sample the model’s own reasoning trajectories.
Use an editor to locate the first failure and propose a minimal replacement span.
Supervise only edited spans, either offline or online as failure modes evolve.
evidence_signal: On ReasonIF with Qwen3-32B, edit-based training substantially improved reasoning-instruction compliance over full-trajectory imitation and trajectory-level reinforcement learning baselines, while largely preserving untargeted skills.
watch_item: Results depend on reliable failure localization and edits; the abstract reports one model and benchmark without numerical effect sizes.
paper_title: Training LLMs to Follow Reasoning Instructions with Minimal Edits
